author: Brewmd
body:
Another vote for Tacos Los Cholos as a premium, foodie favorite.

Los Gueros, or Tacos Manuel would be my recommendation for more traditional street tacos.

And trust me. If you see a taco truck? Eat there.

Especially if they have Pastor on a Trompo. Even more so if the guy is hand carving it and flicking a piece of pineapple onto each taco like a Benihana chef.

You can often find one on Harbor near Orangefair which is just north of Disney, near the Fullerton border. Or on the block over near the front of Target off Orangethorpe. (Or sometimes at Euclid and La Palma, or again on Harbor, across from the Fullerton Costco)

Bonus is that sometimes you’ll find a churro guy set up next to a taco stand.
